native_title: アナタのアイドル～冴えない俺が執着される理由
description:
Kim Jeongtae is an ordinary art instructor who has a girlfriend who he plans to marry. But the famous idol Cherry kidnapped him claiming that she knows him but he doesn't know her. With Cherry constantly making him remember through sex, will Jeongtae finally recognize her?
